ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.12 changes the performance policy to stutter-first: reducing visible frame-time spikes is the primary goal, while average TPS is secondary. The V0.4.11 GenClosest assist is made substantially more conservative. Low-pressure calls stay completely Vanilla; Normal pressure only considers very large IList-backed candidate sets; High/Critical pressure may use a hard-budget nearest-first reorder. RimMT no longer materializes unknown IEnumerable inputs for this feature and no longer uses foreground worker SpinWait/wait budgets. Scratch buffers are reused on the main thread, candidate membership is unchanged, and any slow assist triggers a temporary cooldown. Reachability.CanReach, WorkGiver validators, reservations and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. V0.4.6/V0.4.7 hauling accelerators, bounded path shadow validation, V0.4.8 slow JobPackage tracing and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
